reviewScope.target: Publicly available temporal pickleball stroke footage with stroke labels, documented provenance, and rights suitable for commercial model training
requirements: Downloadable temporal media, not only code, model weights, still images, metadata, or tabular match events
Pickleball-specific stroke labels with temporal boundaries
Documented media provenance and participant or rights-holder authority
License or release that expressly permits the intended commercial model-training use
Enough athlete, technique, camera, and environment diversity for leakage-safe evaluation
reviewScope.conclusion: No reviewed source satisfies all requirements. No public media was downloaded. A consent-first first-party collection is required for the stroke recognizer, phase detector, contact detector, and technique scorer.

sources.name: PickleBall Detection

provenance.limitation: The official project page declares CC BY 4.0 but publishes no collection description or underlying image provenance, so uploader authority over every image cannot be verified from the source page.

limitations: No temporal phase or contact labels
No pose or biomechanical ground truth
Too small to establish athlete, environment, device, and technique coverage

sources.name: Pickleball Pen Ball Tracking

provenance.limitation: The official page declares MIT but does not identify the source media or establish the publisher's authority over it.

limitations: Ball-only object detection; no player, paddle, or stroke label
No temporal stroke, phase, contact, pose, or biomechanics annotation
The 78,592 version count includes tiled and augmented outputs and is not a count of independent source scenes
The published split cannot establish athlete-level separation because athlete identities and source groups are undocumented

evaluatedButExcluded.name: ActionAtlas v1.0 pickleball rows
exclusionReasons: The official repository instructs users to download source videos from YouTube; it distributes metadata, not cleared video media
Both pickleball rows have null source-license metadata
Only one pickleball action is represented
No stroke phase, contact, pose, biomechanics, fault, or coaching-quality annotation

evaluatedButExcluded.name: University of Rochester Pickleball Analytics senior design dataset
exclusionReasons: The institutional page describes a 54-minute professional match recording but offers no downloadable dataset artifact
No media license, participant release, or broadcast-rights grant is published
Labels cover ball location only, not stroke identity or form

evaluatedButExcluded.name: TrackNet-Pickleball repository
exclusionReasons: The repository explicitly excludes video files, label CSVs, and training arrays
The code license does not establish rights to the unspecified pickleball footage used for fine-tuning
Ball tracking is not stroke recognition or form scoring

evaluatedButExcluded.name: pklmart's Competitive Pickleball Extracts
exclusionReasons: No video, pose, temporal phase, or biomechanics data
The declared noncommercial license is incompatible with commercial product training

evaluatedButExcluded.name: Technical and Tactical Performance in Women's Singles Pickleball
exclusionReasons: The release contains SPSS and THEME analysis files, not match video
No frame-level pose, stroke boundary, contact, or form labels

evaluatedButExcluded.name: Pickleball Dataset referenced by the MCTN Scientific Reports paper
exclusionReasons: The paper names a Pickleball Dataset but supplies no live dataset link, count, taxonomy, or provenance
Its data-availability section links to a pickleball research article and the COCO paper rather than a downloadable pickleball artifact
No commercial media rights can be evaluated
